name: MCP contract (any client)
content:
## S.E.E. MCP contract

This run's stories, milestones, knowledge docs, decisions, and workflows live in the S.E.E. store, reached through the `see` MCP server.

- Pass `project` `{{project.id}}` on every MCP tool call.
- Read and change S.E.E. records only through `see` tools. Never edit files under `{{project.hub_root}}/.s_e_e/` directly.
- Reads return a `conflict_token`. Pass the most recent token on every write. A stale token is rejected with the current record; read again and retry.
- Read `see:/projects/{{project.id}}/stories/config` for valid story statuses and label conventions instead of hardcoding them.
- Read `see:/projects/{{project.id}}/workspace-layout` when a task needs the project's folder layout.
- Clients on MCP protocol `2026-07-28` or newer receive `tools/list` in pages; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.
- If the `see` server or a needed tool is unavailable, stop and report it. Do not fall back to editing store files.
